findings.title: Shallow proof mode is not wired to the ordinary test entrypoint
findings.evidence: MODE defaults to green. The test calls runSuiteRepairProof, which dispatches green to runGreen. runGreen still calls git merge-base HEAD main after the expensive seven selector runs. Only the dedicated scopeSelector helper supplies SUITE_REPAIR_PROOF_MODE=scope. Neither package.json nor Vitest configuration supplies that mode for pnpm test. Therefore the shallow proof does not exercise the ordinary aggregate path, whose missing-main and later-main defects remain.
findings.fix: Separate the portable recorded-proof verifier from the dedicated shallow-fixture shape assertions, and wire ordinary selector/aggregate execution to that portable verifier. Keep actual immutable task-base/history auditing in task-time proof capture, keep the seven real focused selector runs and full external aggregate mandatory for task completion, and validate durable boundary/current source and receipt bytes rather than status flags. Do not simply make scope the default: its strict depth-one/detached/no-main assertions would reject normal local checkouts. Add real plain-mode verification in clean shallow and normal full-history checkouts plus source/evidence tamper rejection.
findings.validation_limit: No full aggregate or seven-selector heavy rerun was started, per dispatch. The independent depth-one fetch succeeded, but the detached checkout was rejected by the main-folder guard with exit 126; no bypass was attempted.
